metaTitle: Boutique Website Design India | Live in 48 Hours
metaDescription: Editorial-grade boutique websites that load fast, turn Instagram followers into buyers, and capture enquiries. Designed and live in as little as 48 hours.
headline: A website that looks like a *lookbook* — and loads like lightning.
sub: Most fashion sites make you choose: beautiful or fast. We refuse the trade-off. Editorial visuals, catalogue-ready pages, and an Instagram-to-enquiry funnel that actually converts.

painPoints.title: Gorgeous, but glacial
painPoints.text: Full-bleed imagery gets dumped onto templates never built for it. The result: pages that crawl on mobile, where nearly all your shoppers are. A shopper on patchy 4G will not wait ten seconds for a hemline.

painPoints.title: Instagram is the shop, the site is an afterthought
painPoints.text: Your feed does the selling, then the link in bio lands on a generic homepage with no path to the piece someone just fell for. The scroll ends, the interest dies, and the enquiry never happens.

painPoints.title: No way to actually buy or ask
painPoints.text: A contact form buried three taps deep is not a sales channel. Without a proper catalogue, enquiry flow, or checkout, your website is a brochure — and brochures don't ring the till.

mustHaves.title: Editorial visuals that stay fast
mustHaves.text: Full-screen imagery, modern image formats, and lazy loading tuned so pages feel instant. Every SiteBlitz build targets 90+ Lighthouse scores — beauty and speed, no compromise.

mustHaves.title: A catalogue built like a lookbook
mustHaves.text: Collections presented the way you'd style them: clean grids, generous whitespace, and product pages that let the garment breathe. Filterable, shareable, and easy to update each season.

mustHaves.title: An Instagram-to-site funnel
mustHaves.text: Link-in-bio pages that land followers on the exact collection they saw, with a clear next step: enquire, book a fitting, or buy. Your feed builds desire; your site closes it.

mustHaves.title: Enquiries on WhatsApp, where your clients already are
mustHaves.text: One tap from a product page to a WhatsApp conversation about size, fabric, or availability. Built-in lead capture means no interested buyer slips away unrecorded.

mustHaves.title: Proof you can see in your dashboard
mustHaves.text: A first-party analytics dashboard shows visitors, sources, and enquiry funnels — so you know whether that reel drove traffic, and whether traffic became enquiries. Server-rendered SEO and structured data help shoppers find you on Google too.

faqs.q: Can my site look editorial and still load fast?
faqs.a: Yes — that's the entire point of how we build. Every build targets 90+ Lighthouse scores with images sized for phones, and we publish this site's own real-user Core Web Vitals at /proof, so you can check how we build before you pay.

faqs.q: Do I need full e-commerce, or is an enquiry flow enough?
faqs.a: Depends on how you sell. Made-to-order and high-touch boutiques often convert better through WhatsApp enquiries and fittings — the Growth plan (₹14,999 / $189) covers that. If you want carts and checkout, the Scale plan (₹24,999 / $329) adds full e-commerce with up to 10 pages.

faqs.q: How fast can my boutique site go live?
faqs.a: A one-page site on the Launch plan (₹7,999 / $99) goes live in 48 hours. A multi-page catalogue site on Growth takes 4 days; a full e-commerce build on Scale takes 7. Every plan ships with SEO, WhatsApp integration and lead capture from day one; Growth and Scale add the full analytics dashboard.

cta: Show your collection the way it deserves — live in as little as 48 hours.
